term: Special Interest Group on Information Retrieval
definition: SIGIR is the Association for Computing Machinery's Special Interest Group on Information Retrieval.
details: The scope of the group's specialty is the theory and application of computers to the acquisition, organization, storage, retrieval and distribution of information; emphasis is placed on working with non-numeric information, ranging from natural language to highly structured data bases.
